title: White cowpea (UPL Cp 2): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: White cowpea: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: White cowpea is a cowpea variety from UPLB, Laguna. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: White is a registered cowpea variety, also sold or known as UPL Cp 2. The Philippine Seed Board approved it in 1976. UPLB, Laguna bred it. It takes 57 to 60 days from sowing to the first harvest, with 1.33 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

heroImage.alt: Young mungbean rows beside paddy fields in Candaba, Pampanga, the kind of farm where White cowpea is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for UPL Cp 2, this is the same cowpea. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry. Compare it with the others in our [cowpea variety finder](/crop-varieties/cowpea), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for legumes](/land-preparation/legume-land-preparation).

items: **Days to harvest:** 57 to 60 days from sowing to the first harvest.
**Yield:** 1.33 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

White cowpea takes 57 to 60 days from sowing to the first harvest. That is 5.2 days longer than the average of the 13 cowpea varieties with a day count, 53.3 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 1.33 t/ha trails the average of its group, 5.44. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It was weak against rust, so scout for it from the early weeks.

The pests and diseases that hit cowpea fields most often: [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [bean fly](/pests/bean-fly), [cutworm](/pests/cutworm), [legume pod borer](/pests/legume-pod-borer). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its pods grew about 15 cm long. The seed coat is white.
Where and when to plant White cowpea

Cowpea fits the dry season after rice, on the moisture the paddy keeps. Pick by use: green pods for vegetables, or dry seed. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng gulay](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-gulay).

items.q: Is UPL Cp 2 the same as White?
items.a: Yes. UPL Cp 2 is another name for White. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes 57 to 60 days from sowing to the first harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 1.33 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of White?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
